about_the_game:
This is an engaging 3D VR casual game that takes you deep into the unknown and mysterious ocean world. Under the blue and tranquil sea, there are unimaginable huge dangers.

[img][/img]

You and a group of brave researchers boarded a mini warship called "Watermelon Boat" and embarked on a thrilling deep-sea adventure. However, when you went deep into the hinterland of the ocean, you unexpectedly encountered a huge and ferocious mutant sea monster. These sea monsters are hostile to humans and threaten human safety and peace. Faced with this sudden crisis, you are not afraid and decide to stand up, control the surrounding ships, and start a fierce collision showdown with the sea monster. This battle that broke out in the depths of the ocean will determine the fate of humans and sea monsters, bringing you unprecedented excitement and shock.

[img][/img]

Game Instructions

1.Here, when your right hand touches the touchpad, a selection button ray will appear, and when you pull the right-hand trigger, select the button.

2.The left-hand touchpad controls the player's movement forward, backward, left, and right.

3.Finally, when the left hand presses the menu button, the exit prompt appears. Enjoy your game!
